# `between`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

evaluate if `input` is [not] in between `lower` and `upper`

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
input [NOT] between lower AND upper
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented (SQL syntax) |
| Group | `conditional_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 3 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- between, example 1
> SELECT 0.5 between 0.1 AND 1.0;
true
```

- Added in Spark 1.0.0.
